content: {"episode_id":"ep-05122","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-50","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-50 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, for episode ep-05122. The clinical indication note states the patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10) and reports intermittent episodes of palpitations (R00.2) accompanied by dizziness and giddiness (R42). Per that note, mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and assess for ischemic changes in the context of known coronary artery disease. We request reconsideration of the determination that this diagnostic modality was not medically necessary based on these documented indications."}
